svg.title: Mali GPU Memory Free Sequence (Detailed Core Path)

g.text: Mali GPU Memory Free Sequence (Detailed Core Path)
Clear pending_regions entry, set cookie free
Check flags, unlink reg, handle evictable
Acquire mmu_lock, Walk page tables, Invalidate entries
Free page table pages if empty (calls internal helpers)
Post-unmap cleanup (type specific, calls internal helpers)
(via kbase_region_refcnt_free below, or other internal calls)
Cleanup based on alloc->type (Unmap DMA, Unpin User, etc)
Remove VA region from tracker (e.g. kbase_remove_va_region, if mapped)
